'''Hirom Pinkatta''' was a [[Professor/Legends|professor]] and member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Astrographic Survey Institute]]. Pinkatta compiled the Institute's report on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drall (planet)|Drall]].
